## About Grafschaft in Zahlen

**Grafschaft in Zahlen** is an independent statistics project about the Grafschaft Bentheim district and its municipalities. Its aim is to present predominantly official and publicly available data in a clear, transparent and accessible way, and to make long-term and regional developments visible.

The project is a private, independent initiative and is not an official website of the Grafschaft Bentheim district.
